name: gabis-job-hunter
description: Gabis Job Hunter: finds matching roles on company career sites and LinkedIn, writes calm, true one-page cover letters, applies after your approval (career sites and LinkedIn Easy Apply), and keeps a tracker plus one folder per application. Every session runs as an agent team: a LinkedIn Easy Apply raider, job crawlers, an off-script headhunter and posting gaters in parallel, a duplicate guard so you never apply twice, an approval desk, letter writers and an independent letter reviewer, on models chosen by a cost-quality frontier. Set up once from your CV, then say "find me jobs".
